data.name: Drive UP: Together
data.detailed_description:
You and your friends. One road. Straight up.

Drive UP: Together is a physics-based co-op racing game where every corner is a negotiation, every hill is a challenge, and every crash is a memory you'll laugh about for years.

🚗 Feel Every Wheel

The cars in Drive UP: Together handle like they mean it. Weight shifts under acceleration, tires push back on tight bends, and every surface feels alive beneath you. Whether you're crawling up a switchback or launching off a crest at full throttle, you'll feel it in your hands.

This isn't arcade flick-and-go. It's physics driving made accessible, satisfying, and wildly fun.

🤝 Better Together and Messier Together

Co-op is the heart of Drive UP: Together. Your friends aren't just passengers; they're co-pilots, competitors, and chaos agents all at once.

Coordinate to conquer the toughest climbs. Argue over the best line. Watch in horror as someone takes the shortcut that definitely wasn't a shortcut.

📈 The Road Only Goes Up

Each run is a vertical challenge. The goal is simple: get higher. The execution? Anything but.

Tight courses, unpredictable physics interactions, and a crew of friends who may or may not be helping. Drive UP: Together turns every meter of altitude into a story.

🎮 Built for Car People. Loved by Everyone.

Whether you live and breathe horsepower or you just want a great time with friends on a Friday night, Drive UP: Together meets you where you are. Easy to pick up. Hard to put down. Impossible to play without laughing.

Grab your crew. Start the engine. Drive UP Together.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-5500 or newer
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 920M or equivalent
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10-11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500 or newer
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1050ti or newer
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
